source.description: project, repo_rev, input_manifest_sha256, image digest, harness, model, launcher version

observed.description: measured by the launcher: run_id, status, stop_reason, tool_calls, usage, files[{path,size,sha256,change:changed|deleted,in_assigned_scope}], error

worker_claims.description: the model's self-reported JSON block; never trusted as evidence

cleanup_status.description: teardown outcome measured by the launcher; 'timed_out' or 'failed' means the sandbox teardown was bounded and did not confirm
